newsitem.title: JAPAN: Apple Comp aims for Y258 bln Japan sales in 96/97.
newsitem.headline: Apple Comp aims for Y258 bln Japan sales in 96/97.

text.p: Apple Computer Inc is aiming for 258 billion yen worth of sales in Japan in the 1996/97 business year, Tetsuya Shiga, president of Apple Japan Inc, said on Tuesday.
That is compared to sales of 218 billion yen in the previous business year.
"Since the Japanese market is still following the American market, there is still a lot of room for growth," said Shiga.
He also said that the company hopes to ship a total of 1.1 million Apple computers in Japan in the 1996/97 business year, up from 893,000 units in the previous year.
Visiting Apple Computer Inc chief executive Gilbert Amelio told the same news conference: "We are very committed to the Japanese market and we will introduce some products first in Japan."
